output.title: Metric help text corrected for renewal timestamp
output.content: The environment has cert-manager v1.17.0 installed with prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled configured, indicating Prometheus monitoring is active. The change corrects the help text of the `certmanager_certificate_renewal_timestamp_seconds` metric to clarify it measures time relative to certificate expiration, not Unix epoch. Inspect your Prometheus scrape configuration and metric consumers to confirm whether this metric is actively queried; if it is, the corrected help text will improve metric interpretation.
